surface_mechanism_description: The effectiveness of O2 treatments in removing the humps indicates that they are due to oxygen vacancies in the bulk LaAlO3. The Frenkel-Poole (FP) conduction mechanism usually fits well with defect-rich ALD HfO2 films. During FP conduction, trapped charge carriers hop between potential wells that define the trap states, and an applied electric field enhances the hopping state because of the barrier-lowering effect.
